Chat request with tool_choice set to required forces the model to call a tool

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
use Liter\Llm\Choice;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["messages" => [["content" => "What is the weather today?", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "gpt-4", "toolChoice" => "required", "tools" => [["function" => ["description" => "Get the current weather for a given location", "name" => "get_weather", "parameters" => ["properties" => ["location" => ["description" => "The city name", "type" => "string"]], "required" => ["location"], "type" => "object"]], "toolType" => "function"]]]));
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->chat($req);
var_dump($result->getChoices());
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->getMessage()->getToolCalls());
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->getMessage()->getToolCalls()[0]->getFunction()->name);
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->finishReason);
```
